rationale: Built and executed all three pins: codex is the only one that grants exactly the current issue/agent drop while validating COORD_ISSUE, rejecting a symlinked drop, and proving it with an end-to-end test that runs the real launchers against stub harnesses, whereas cursor's build passes no completes directory to any launcher so no harness is granted anything and Codex keeps danger-full-access, and my own build lacks codex's receipt-read hardening and --completes-root option; codex's two defects (an empty-array expansion that aborts the launcher on macOS /bin/bash 3.2, and a mailbox default that collides for two workspaces sharing a parent) are local edits rather than missing mechanism.
